〔115 統測〕 21–24

▲ 下篇短文共有 4 個空格，為第 21 － 24 題，請依短文文意，選出一個最適合該空格的答案。

May 18 is International Day for Women in Maritime, which recognizes the importance of women in the ocean transport industry. The theme for 2025 was “An Ocean of Opportunities for Women.” In Taiwan, women represent only 4 % of seafarers ( 航海人員 ) . **21** the 260 women seafarers, many have proved that seafaring can be a rewarding career. One woman who shows the way is Huang Chao-ling ( 黃昭玲 ) . Huang, who was a captain, is Taiwan’s first and only female harbor pilot. As a harbor pilot, she guides ships safely in and out of the port, which is a **22** job that requires taking risks, such as climbing onto a moving ship in big waves. Another front-runner is Lin Chia-ling ( 林嘉玲 ) , Taiwan’s first woman oil tanker captain. Lin’s job is to ensure reliable delivery of oil to all ports in Taiwan, **23** the weather is terrible. Huang and Lin share a hard career path, given that women seafarers face various challenges, including insufficient onboard facilities. Today, the maritime industry is working to create a gender-friendly workplace **24** . Such efforts are seeing results, with the number of Taiwanese women captains standing at 22 in 2024, up from 6 about ten years ago.

▲ 下篇短文共有 4 個空格，為第 25 － 28 題，請依短文文意，選出一個最適合該空格的答案。

The Tamkang Bridge ( 淡江大橋 ) has been under construction since 2019 and is ready for use this year. It was built because the Tamsui ( 淡水 ) and Bali ( 八里 ) areas have grown quickly in recent years, and more people now commute between them. Once it opens, people can save about half an hour when traveling between the two places. Besides making **25** smooth, the bridge will also appeal to visitors with its special architectural style. It was designed by the world-famous architect Zaha Hadid. Being the first bridge in Taiwan **26** through an international design competition, the Tamkang Bridge will become the world’s longest single-tower asymmetric cable-stayed bridge ( 單塔不對稱斜張橋 ) . Expressing a sense of art and beauty, the bridge’s 200-meter tower rises into the sky, **27** a dancer were lifting both hands in prayer. Moreover, the bridge’s shape goes well with the sunset over the Tamsui River, making the view much more eye-catching. Visitors can appreciate the riverside views here. With shorter travel time between Tamsui and Bali and its unique beauty, the Tamkang Bridge will play an important role in both **28** . The bridge will definitely bring travel convenience and recreational benefits to the people of northern Taiwan.

y115_q24.text:
〔115 統測〕 31–32

▲ 閱讀下文，回答第 31 － 32 題

Read the following line chart and paragraph about energy. Then answer the questions.

Renewable energy in Taiwan includes solar energy. Solar energy comes from natural sources, renews quickly, and does not produce large amounts of greenhouse gases. When considering the transition to solar energy, it is important to weigh both the advantages and disadvantages. One major advantage of solar energy is that sunlight is plentiful and does not run out like natural gas or oil. Solar power can also help lower electricity bills. Besides, with owned solar panels, the property value can be increased. However, solar energy has some challenges. Since it depends on sunlight, we need battery storage systems to save the energy for cloudy days and nighttime. Although these systems are quite expensive, they provide limited energy storage. In addition, solar panels also require a lot of space, which can be a problem in crowded urban areas.

〔115 統測〕 33–35

▲ 閱讀下文，回答第 33 － 35 題

As the chart below shows, Din Tai Fung ( 鼎泰豐 ) has emerged as the top-performing restaurant in the United States ( US ) in terms of revenue per store, according to the 2025 Technomic Top 500 Chain Restaurant Report.

Founded in 1958 in Taiwan as a cooking oil business, Din Tai Fung began selling *xiao long bao* in 1972 in Taipei. About 25 years later, it opened its first American branch store in Los Angeles. Over the years, it has expanded to 180 branch stores in 13 countries around the world.

Din Tai Fung’s success was not achieved through expensive ads. Instead, the restaurant chain has built its brand on global consistent product excellence, operational discipline, and social media buzz. Whether in Los Angeles or Taipei, customers experience the same taste and service. Every Din Tai Fung *xiao long bao* is folded exactly 18 times and weighs precisely 21 grams. Through glass walls, customers can see chefs in the kitchen, making *xiao long bao* with exactness and care. The way the chefs make the food, the steam coming off the baskets, and the perfect look of each dish all make for great photos and videos. Customers post the pictures and share their dining experience widely online, giving the brand effective publicity. The consistent quality, combined with visual pleasure and the power of social media, has made Din Tai Fung successful and popular in the US.

y115_q26.text:
〔115 統測〕 36–38

▲ 閱讀下文，回答第 36 － 38 題

Recent studies show that teenagers experience more anxiety and mental health issues than those in earlier generations. In his book *The Anxious Generation: How the Great Rewiring of Childhood Is Causing an Epidemic of Mental Illness*, Professor Jonathan Haidt explains that two major changes in childhood are mainly responsible for their problems.

First, these young people lost real-world freedom during childhood. Their parents tended to protect them too much and carefully control their daily activities. They were not encouraged to explore outdoors, take risks, and solve problems independently. As a result, they might have missed many opportunities to develop confidence and independence. According to Professor Haidt, plenty of free, unsupervised outdoor play is important for healthy development. Without outdoor play, children may be less willing to try new things as they grow into teenagers.

Another major change is the shift from a play-based childhood to a phone-based one. Since childhood, these young people have often spent many hours using smartphones and social media for leisure activities. This leads to several problems. For example, they do not get enough sleep because of long hours on screens. Instead of interacting face to face, they often communicate online, making them feel less connected to people in the real world. Also, constant phone messages and addictive apps make it hard for them to stay focused. When they cannot check their phones, they feel anxious.

y115_q27.text:
〔115 統測〕 39–42

▲ 閱讀下文，回答第 39 － 42 題

Taiwan is a global high-tech powerhouse because of its dynamic industries. Of these, the electronics industry is best known for its importance in the digital age. This industry has a competitive strength which was built from years of developing expertise in electronics manufacturing.

Electronics manufacturing in Taiwan began around the mid-20th century. Initially, companies produced mainly components according to customers’ designs and requirements, functioning as contract manufacturers for other brands. In the process, they learned to adapt, innovate, and compete. By the 1990s, Taiwan had become a global leader in computer and notebook production. Major manufacturers developed the expert skills and knowledge for product designing and innovation. Today, some of them are able to provide a full range of electronics manufacturing services ( EMS ). These EMS providers serve various industries that include computing, communications, and consumer electronics. Four Taiwanese manufacturers have made it onto the list of the world’s top ten EMS providers.

Taiwan’s electronics industry owes its success to several factors. First, there is a ready pool of professionals to meet industry needs. Secondly, official policies provide the necessary industrial support. Thirdly, a wide network of local suppliers adds to better efficiency and innovation. Last but not least, manufacturers pay special attention to producing high-quality products, rather than competing on price.

Currently, the great demand for AI products offers new business opportunities. Manufacturers who **ride the wave of change** are making more money from AI servers than from iPhones. For the first time, AI-related products have beaten consumer electronics in manufacturing business. In fact, Taiwan made over 80 percent of the world’s AI servers ( 伺服器 ) in 2025. Quite clearly, this demonstrates the ability of Taiwan’s electronics industry to move forward with technology.

options: In a phone-based world, teenagers will spend more time on digital technologies like virtual reality and online shopping. These technologies will help them solve problems effectively, so companies should develop new features to meet their needs.

To address these concerns, teenagers should be allowed to use social media for two reasons: to make new friends and to talk to people face to face. In this way, they will become more confident about their future.
